Controls & Commands

Keyboard
W A S D / arrows – walk / drive
Shift – run · Space – jump · C – crouch
F – enter / exit vehicle · E – interact · T – chat · M – map · H – horn · Esc – close

Touch
Green stick – move · ⤒ jump · 🏃 run · 🚪 vehicle · ⌖ aim · 👊 attack · 💬 chat

Chat commands
/me text – action of your character
/do text – describe the scene
/try text – random success / fail
/todo text*action
/b text – out-of-character chat
/s text – shout
/id – your ID · /time – server time
/tp place – teleport to building (e.g. /tp army)
/places – list buildings · /car – vehicle · /money
/clear – clear chat · /help – this panel
